content.text: Find out more about DenmarkWhy visit DenmarkOutdoor Adventures: Denmark's stunning landscapes offer numerous outdoor activities, including kayaking along its scenic coastlines.Cultural Richness: Immerse yourself in Denmark's vibrant culture by visiting its historic churches, galleries, and museums.Family-Friendly Activities: Enjoy a variety of attractions and events that cater to families, ensuring a fun experience for all.Charming Cities: Explore picturesque cities like Copenhagen, known for their welcoming locals and romantic settings.Cozy Accommodations: Choose from a range of vacation rentals, including charming cottages and beach houses for a memorable stay.Popular types of accommodation in DenmarkIf you're searching for the perfect getaway in Denmark, look no further. Our platform offers a variety of vacation rentals to suit every traveler’s needs. From cozy apartments and houses to inviting caravan parks, you’ll find the ideal spot to unwind. Explore charming cottage rentals, delightful beach house rentals, and holiday homes in Denmark that promise a memorable experience. Your dream vacation awaits.Apartments: The top choice for vacation rentals in Denmark, offering modern amenities and convenient locations for an enjoyable stay.Houses: A popular option for families and friends, providing spacious and comfortable living spaces for your getaway.Caravan Parks: A unique experience, these parks offer a mix of outdoor adventure and cozy accommodations.Cottages: Charming and quaint, perfect for those seeking a rustic retreat amidst Denmark’s beautiful landscapes.Condos: A stylish and comfortable option, ideal for travelers looking for a blend of luxury and location.**Top attractions in DenmarkDenmark offers an ideal setting for outdoor, family, and adventure vacations, featuring popular attractions like churches, beaches, and galleries. Travelers can immerse themselves in a rich cultural experience while enjoying outdoor activities. Kayaking in Denmark is a must-try for those seeking adventure on the water, making it a perfect addition to your itinerary as you explore the country's stunning landscapes and vibrant local culture.LEGOLAND® Billund: A fantastic theme park filled with interactive rides and attractions, LEGOLAND® Billund offers a unique experience for families. Enjoy themed areas, LEGO-building workshops, and entertaining shows that spark creativity and imagination.Tivoli Gardens: This enchanting amusement park combines thrill rides with beautiful gardens, making it perfect for family adventures. Experience the magical atmosphere with live entertainment, delicious dining options, and stunning floral displays.Nyhavn: A picturesque canal lined with colorful buildings and charming cafés, Nyhavn is a great spot to relax and soak in the friendly local vibes. Enjoy a leisurely stroll or take a boat tour to appreciate the beauty of this historic waterfront.Things to do recommended for couplesReady for a romantic getaway in Denmark? Explore the enchanting canals of Copenhagen on a cozy boat ride, or take a leisurely walk through the colorful Nyhavn district. Don't miss a sunset picnic at the picturesque Tivoli Gardens for a magical end to your day.Things to do recommended for familiesYour family will delight in exploring Tivoli Gardens in Copenhagen, where enchanting rides and beautiful gardens await. Visit Legoland Billund for a day of fun with interactive LEGO exhibits, or discover the fascinating world of animals at Copenhagen Zoo. Each experience promises lasting memories for all ages.Things to do recommended for groupsExplore the vibrant Nyhavn Harbor in Copenhagen with your group, enjoy a guided bike tour through the city’s historic sites, or relax with a picnic in the beautiful Tivoli Gardens. Don’t miss the chance to experience local cuisine at a cozy Danish eatery.*Distances are measured in a straight line; actual driving distances may vary depending on the route.What do I need to keep in mind when booking a vacation in DenmarkWhen planning a trip, whether you're traveling with a group, family, pets, or looking for extended stays, it's important to filter your options based on your top priorities. Thankfully, you can easily apply filters for these options and much more on Vrbo.Traveling to Denmark with young kids: Traveling with young children can be quite demanding. It's important to prioritize their comfort and safety, along with suitable amenities like a private swimming pool. Additionally, it's wise to think about how close you are to family-friendly attractions.Taking your pets with you to Denmark: For many, a family vacation isn't truly fulfilling without their furry companion by their side. If you can relate, explore Vrbo listings that welcome pets. Most of these pet-friendly accommodations offer feeding bowls and beds, ensuring that everyone feels comfortable and at home.Planning for a long term stay visiting Denmark: If you're in search of vacation rentals that offer special rates for stays of a month or more, you've come to the right spot. By using the appropriate filters, you can effortlessly discover and save on monthly rentals. Don't forget to include features like a parking space, a well-equipped kitchen, or a private pool in your search criteria as well.Where to stay in DenmarkDenmark offers an unforgettable vacation experience, blending stunning Danish beaches with rich cultural heritage. Explore vibrant cities like Copenhagen, where friendly locals welcome you to family-friendly activities and romantic settings. Enjoy the picturesque landscapes and outdoor adventures that define this Scandinavian gem. Whether you're considering holiday bookings or looking for cozy rentals, Denmark's charm and diverse atmospheres make it a perfect destination for every traveler.Copenhagen: As the vibrant capital of Denmark, Copenhagen is a bustling city renowned for its mix of historic charm and modern innovation. Nestled along the eastern coast of the island of Zealand, it offers a wealth of attractions, from the enchanting Tivoli Gardens amusement park to the picturesque Nyhavn harbor lined with colorful townhouses. The city’s extensive bike paths make it perfect for outdoor enthusiasts, while its bustling shopping areas and entertainment facilities ensure a dynamic urban experience. Don't miss the iconic Little Mermaid statue and the lively canals that weave through the city, providing a unique perspective on Copenhagen's beauty.Copenhagen City Centre: Located at the heart of Copenhagen, the City Centre is a vibrant neighborhood brimming with energy and family-friendly activities. This area is a hub for shopping, dining, and entertainment, with attractions such as the famous Strøget pedestrian street and the historic Tivoli Gardens nearby. Visitors can enjoy leisurely strolls along the scenic canals or explore the thriving marina. The City Centre seamlessly combines outdoor experiences with urban charm, making it an ideal destination for families looking to immerse themselves in Danish culture and leisure.Aarhus: Aarhus, Denmark's second-largest city, is a cultural gem located on the east coast of the Jutland peninsula. Known for its youthful vibe and outdoor activities, Aarhus is perfect for family adventures and entertainment. Visitors can explore the renowned amusement park, Tivoli Friheden, or take a swing at one of the many golf courses in the area. The city is also home to stunning landmarks, such as the historic Aarhus Cathedral and the vibrant waterfront. With its rich blend of culture, green spaces, and engaging attractions, Aarhus offers an exciting and enriching travel experience.Best time to go to DenmarkIf you're planning a trip to Denmark, it's a good idea to check both the weather and property rates. The warmest month is August. Peak season runs in January and June to July, while off-peak times, like October to December tend to have fewer bookings and better deals.Booking with Vrbo is simpleAre you hoping to save on your next adventure? Your saved and booked properties are neatly categorized into Potential, Upcoming, or Current Trips. To discover more about Trip Boards, please visit: https://www.vrbo.com/trips.**Based on Vrbo properties bookings.Scandinavian charms on the shores of Denmark The Kingdom of Denmark draws travelers to its charming Scandinavian towns, colorful harbors, picturesque islands and lavish castles and palaces. Sitting on a peninsula, the country is almost entirely surrounded by water, so there's no shortage of scenic coastline and summertime fun. Whether you head to the capital city of Copenhagen for culture immersion or spend a relaxing holiday on the west coast with incredible views over the North Sea, you'll find a Denmark vacation rental that suits your vacation style. Once you've booked your stay, it's off to admire stunning gardens or take the kids to action-packed theme parks. Exploring Denmark's royal grounds If your Denmark vacation rental is near Copenhagen, you'll want to spend some time exploring the top sites in the capital city. Tivoli Gardens is a popular stop for the whole family to enjoy, with an aquarium and all sorts of entertaining rides and games available. The picturesque setting is full of colorful flowers and grassy spots for lounging. With both the Christiansborg and Amalienborg palaces in the city, you'll have your fill of royal history, while the Renaissance Frederiksborg Castle, just outside of town, offers guided tours of its museum, filled with paintings and an assortment of historic artifacts. Touring Denmark by bike and boat Sightseeing tours are a great way to immerse yourself in the culture of this Scandinavian gem, with all sorts of different options offered around the capital city. Copenhagen is a bike-friendly town, so plenty of cycling excursions are available. Alternatively, opt for walking tours that will lead you to some of the top culture highlights of the city. Guided boat rides along the canal are a great way to enjoy the outdoors in summer, while snapping photos of the famous colorful buildings that line the waterway. You can also grab a canoe or kayak to paddle around on your own. Springing into the warm season in Denmark Spring and summer bring life and color to Denmark, as the warmer temperatures invite visitors to the city for bike rides and festivals. You can expect average summer highs in the 60s here, perfect for cycling or hopping on boat rides along the colorful canals, while evenings stay cool enough to call for sweaters. The peak months of July and August bring the most travelers, especially to the capital city, so be sure to book your Denmark vacation rental early, if you plan to visit in summer. The spring months, although a bit chilly, offer a reprieve from crowds. Off to the islands and parks of Denmark Denmark's peninsula location means lots of gorgeous coastline to explore, on hikes or boat rides, with everything from soaring sea cliffs to sandy beaches along the water. A series of offshore islands, including the remote Faroe Islands, can be reached by ferry or plane. A couple of parks on the west coast of Denmark offer perfect spots to enjoy some of the coastal scenery. The National Park to the north is full of lakes and sand dunes, while Wadden Sea National Park, a large habitat of marshes and islands, gets regular visits from seal species and migrating birds.
